scientific_integrity: The proof is self-contained and analytical; finite numerical checks are not used for the universal assertion. Claims of independent verification are not made.
scientific_limitations: Only homogeneous degree-two input at p=1. No determination of unrestricted H1 to A1 norm. Finite numerical checks supplement exact analysis. Historical precise n=1 Nikolskii coverage remains possible.
title: The exact quadratic norm of diagonal Hardy-to-Bergman restriction
